seo_desc: Is your chatbot promising fake discounts? We implement B2B AI Guardrails to block hallucinations, protect your data, and prevent lawsuits in your company.
author_pitch: I've seen SMEs lose thousands of euros because their chatbot promised impossible refunds. My mission is to shield your AI systems so they are accurate, secure, and don't ruin your reputation.
title: Guardrails for B2B AI: Stop Your Chatbot From Lying and Ruining Your Profitability
body:
Is your customer service chatbot promising refunds and discounts that do not exist?

Implementing pure, unfiltered artificial intelligence in your store or B2B platform is commercial suicide. LLM models are designed to predict words, not to tell the truth. Without containment barriers, your virtual assistant can invent return policies, leak internal prompts to your competition, or compromise your clients' confidential data, costing you thousands of euros in lawsuits and corporate reputation loss.

The trap of "Plug & Play" AI

Believing that just connecting the OpenAI API to your website and giving it a basic prompt is enough is the biggest operational risk today. When a customer pressures the AI, it collapses and "hallucinates" answers to please the user. Limitless intelligence is not innovation, it is a critical security breach.

Our solution: Semantic Guardrails Architecture

At LANZAESTUDIO, we implement an intermediate security layer (Guardrails) powered by advanced RAG techniques and real-time validation. It audits every user input and every model output before the message is published. If the bot attempts to hallucinate an offer or diverts the conversation away from your commercial interest, the Guardrail instantly blocks and intercepts the response.

  1. Prompt Injection Filter: We block social engineering attacks attempting to "hack" your bot to extract your secret business instructions.
  2. Anti-Hallucination Wall: We cross-reference the AI's response against a strict vector database containing your policies; if the answer isn't there, it is not sent.
  3. Topic Fencing: We force the AI to speak exclusively about your products and services, preventing it from acting as a generic consultant or discussing politics.
  4. Real-Time PII Anonymization: We automatically mask credit card numbers, IDs, and emails before they touch the external LLM, ensuring GDPR compliance.

The Real Impact on Your Business

  • Zero financial losses: Total eradication of invented discounts or out-of-policy refund promises that force you to absorb losses.
  • Guaranteed regulatory compliance: Legal protection by preventing the involuntary leakage of corporate data (PII) through your virtual assistant.
  • Unwavering brand trust: 100% accurate interactions that build user loyalty, projecting professionalism instead of chaotic and robotic responses.
